correctness.rationale: The Petersen model GP(12,5) of the Nauru graph and Cayley permutation-star graph on S4 are identified by the explicit 24-vertex permutation mapping and 36 adjacencies in the inspected source. Left S4 and right S3 actions supply 144 automorphisms; the colored point-neighborhood refinement gives an upper bound 24×3!=144. Independent inclusion/exclusion gives 35,219 augmented independent subsets with face counts (24,240,1304,4212,8328,10036,7176,2964,752,156,24,2). Source verifier constructs an acyclic Hasse matching with 17,605 pairs leaving six critical five-cells and three six-cells, and a signed integral 6×3 Morse matrix rank two with unit minor; hence rational H5 dimension4 and H6 dimension1. For each of 144 group actions, compatible cycles of vertices determine the signed reduced Lefschetz character in all 15 S4×S3 classes; explicit S4/S3 orthogonality gives virtual difference sign4⊗1 -(S^(2,1,1)+sign4)⊗sign3. The one-dimensional H6 dimension together with nonnegative multiplicity determines H6=sign4⊗1, H5=(sign4⊗P4)⊗sign3. The lack of full invariants and presence of A4×A3 invariant lines follow. No equivariant Morse matching is assumed.
